note: [agent-bulk] nuecc. shw 8022 (801.3 MeV, 32 seg, 164.3 cm): single apex at the nu vertex, one narrow stem opening into a cone; the yellow member set covers the whole visible body on both azimuths (az-055 and az+085) and out to the far on-axis stubs. Nothing contiguous and unclaimed inside the cone: the only non-member on the acceptance plot near the pass-1 step is 36043 (2.4 MeV, 0.6 cm) at 127 cm / 12.9 deg, negligible. 8017 (pdg 2212, 13.1 cm, cluster 8, closest point on the shower start) is a separate prong on the far side of the star and is correctly left unowned; that is a PID-flavoured statement and I did not test it. shw 60090 (103.8 MeV, single 17.9 cm segment) is a detached compact EM blob at 46 cm / 85 deg from 8022's axis, fully claimed, with every other segment in the event at >=93 deg from its axis, so nothing to add. No reco pi0 group, and pairing 8022+60090 prices at 383.7 MeV (axis convention) / kine_pio 392.0 MeV, nowhere near 135 -- the absence of a pi0 group looks right, not like a pairing failure. Looked at 2 of 15 showers; the 13 skipped by the scope rule are 18.7 MeV (13039) and below, twelve of them under 4 MeV. Verdict is about clustering only.
